about: Read only lines 10 to 20 of log.md with your file read tool, once, and tell me the last line you were shown. Don't run commands. A read of lines 10 to 20 of a long file, so a harness's own cut can be told from one the model asked for.

known.line: note: Warning — Codex could not find bubblewrap on PATH. Install bubblewrap with your OS package manager. See the sandbox prerequisites: https://developers.openai.com/codex/co…
